purpose: Teach: 履き/怪しげ/一人前/ありゃ/競う/似合わ/着々と/とてつもなく

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、新しい靴下履きすぎだろ
lines.en: Riku, you're going through new socks like crazy.
lines.style: Teasing lilt on 'new socks' — playful jab delivered over the shoulder. Quick, dry. The tone of someone who's noticed something small and ridiculous and has to call it out.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、その怪しげな人物には近づくなよ、桜
lines.en: Hey — stay away from that sketchy person, Sakura.
lines.style: Sudden shift to serious. Firm opening, protective undertone. Not lecturing — warning her because it matters. Brief, no room for argument.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、一人前になるまで頑張れ
lines.en: Riku, keep working hard until you're full-fledged.
lines.style: Earnest encouragement with a touch of teasing affection. Slight smile in the voice. Not condescending — like she's rooting for him and letting him know she sees the effort.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、「ありゃ」って言いすぎだぞ、桜
lines.en: You say 'huh?' way too much, Sakura.
lines.style: Light mock-exasperation. Wry amusement. The tone of someone pointing out a habit they've heard too often. Gentle jab, no real heat.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、俺と競うなよ
lines.en: Riku, don't go competing with me.
lines.style: Casual challenge with underlying confidence. Slight smirk. Playful superiority — not mean, just the tone of someone who knows she'd win.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、その帽子、お前に似合わなくはないぞ、桜
lines.en: That hat doesn't look bad on you, actually, Sakura.
lines.style: Genuine observation, slightly awkward delivery. Hesitant on 'actually' — like he's admitting something he didn't mean to say out loud. Quiet sincerity beneath the surface.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のテスト点、着々と上がってんな
lines.en: Your test scores are going up steadily, Riku.
lines.style: Warm approval with quiet pride. Observant — like she's been noticing the trend. Affectionate tone, no performance. Just stating a fact she's glad to see.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、課題の量がとてつもなく多いな、桜
lines.en: You've got an insane amount of homework, Sakura.
lines.style: Sympathetic observation with dry humor. Slight shake of the head in the voice. Commiserating — he's noticing her burden and pointing it out as a moment of recognition, not complaint.
